subplayer.release_notes: v1.3.1: Knob values (LEVEL/ATTACK/RELEASE/FILTER) now carry over when scrolling the sound bank instead of resetting. PITCH knob removed — 5-knob row. CHOKE ("cut itself") switch verified. UPDATE button now points at the real update feed.

lock.release_notes: First release. Automatic vocal alignment: always listening, captures on vocal, aligns dubs to the lead. Never mutes your live vocal.

studio-rack.release_notes: v1.1.1: Scrollable 19-inch hardware-rack redesign — all 9 faceplates stacked in signal-flow order in a stained-wood cabinet with black rails (no more tabs). No per-unit bottom strips: every knob drags directly on its faceplate. Live meters on every unit (1176/CL 1B GR needles, Pro-L 2 GR/IN/OUT bars, Pro-DS activity LED), clickable 1176 ratio buttons, per-faceplate ON/OFF power toggles with obvious bypass dimming. Slim header (title/version/UPDATE) + slim footer (master IN/OUT). DSP unchanged from v1.1.0.
